name: Tenshi Ami
source:
An angel who came down from heaven to study humans. But alas, her scatterbrained disposition leads to one failure after another.

She loves donuts with a fanatic passion, to the point that when she sees one, she can't think about anything else.

Birthday: Unknown
Likes: Donuts! D-O-N-U-T-S!
Dislikes: Big dogs
Hobby: Walking while eating donuts
